contract.sharing_contract: anyone-with-the-link EDIT (Drive permission type=anyone, role=writer) is intentional and must be preserved; never migrate to named-user-only (F02).
contract.idempotency_contract: provisioning_key = company_id::planner_kind; Drive readback on appProperties skill35_provisioning_key before copy; replay returns the existing file with deduped=true (F15). Durable claim/ledger lives in the ONB/CC caller.

repair_contract.verification: F14 — BEFORE provisioning completes, the template sheet's metadata is read with the SAME credential class the copy uses (googleDriveOAuth2Api), verifying the template is reachable and expected to exist. The provisioned sheet's metadata is then read back with the Sheets credential the appends use (Verify Provisioned Sheet + Registry Verification step in INSTALL.md) before the receipt is returned.
repair_contract.transient: 5xx/429/network failures on the copy are transient: bounded retries (retryOnFail, maxTries 3, 2s backoff) before the error receipt.
repair_contract.classification: 404 on the template => 'template_not_found' (identity repair: fix templateSheetId). 403 => 'template_access_denied' (access repair: re-grant operator access to the EXISTING template). Neither ever silently creates a replacement sheet.

error_schema.repair_action: specific actionable repair instruction (identity vs access)

input_schema.templateSheetId: string (required, Google Sheet ID of the fleet template)

output_schema.sharedWith: literal(anyone with the link can edit)

credential_references: googleDriveOAuth2Api — select the operator Google Drive credential on: Copy Template Sheet, Set Anyone Can Edit, Drive Readback, Tag Provisioning Key (re-wire after import; never committed).
